title: Dillon Motor Speedway

services.name: South East Mini Stock Tour
services.desc: A. Competing Models: 1972 thru present mass produced 4 cylinder passenger cars, 2 or 4 door models allowed. No convertibles, mini vans, or trucks. No rear, mid, or opposed engines allowed. No AWD, AWD conversions, or 4×4 models permitted. Preapproval of any questionable make/model required. B. Overall weights: All racecars will weight a minimum of 2200 lbs with a 55% maximum left

blurb: The original 4/10 mile dirt oval opened around 1966 as Dillon County Raceway, operating through 1973. It reopened from 1977 to 1980. In 2006, badly over grown, it was bought by Ron Barfield. The track was paved and given new life. The 2007 season was the first for the new Dillon Motor Speedway.
